column2: By-Law on the Maintenance of Hotels within the Authoritative Area of Kahawaththa P radeshiya Sabha
This By-Law is enacted to regulate, administer and control the operation of hotels within the area of authority
This by-law is known as the by-law of operating a hotel within the area of the Kahawaththa pradeshiya sabha.
No person shall operate a hotel within the premises of the Kahawaththa Pradeshiya Sabha (hereinafter referred
to as the Pradeshiya Sabha) unless there is a valid license issued by it to the Chairman.
Every person applying for a license under this by-law shall apply for a license under an application prepared in
accordance with the first subsection herein.
